narrative:

and high variability (CV=0.95). Lead time is volatile with mean 3.08 days.

The recommended policy increases safety stock from 215 to 413 units to achieve 
95% service level, while optimizing order quantity to 1910 units 
(EOQ would be 2274 but constrained by storage capacity).

This optimization yields annual cost savings of $8561.55 (78.0%) by 
reducing ordering frequency from 142.6 to 16.1 orders per year, 
despite higher holding costs from increased inventory.

Reorder when inventory reaches 777 units. Review cycle: approximately 17 days.
